metadata.description: Viking and Norse cluster — legendary Norse figures and key media works depicting the Viking Age. Currently zero coverage in the knowledge graph.

figures.name: Ragnar Lothbrok
figures.title: Viking king and legendary hero
figures.description: Semi-legendary Norse hero and king whose saga describes raids on England and Francia, said to have been killed by King Aella of Northumbria in a pit of snakes

figures.name: Rollo of Normandy
figures.title: First Duke of Normandy
figures.description: Viking chieftain who besieged Paris and was granted the territory of Normandy by King Charles the Simple, founding the dynasty that produced William the Conqueror

figures.name: Leif Erikson
figures.title: Norse explorer
figures.description: Norse explorer believed to be the first European to set foot on the North American continent, establishing a brief settlement at Vinland around 1000 AD

figures.name: Harald Hardrada
figures.title: King of Norway
figures.description: The last great Viking king, who served in the Varangian Guard in Constantinople before becoming King of Norway, killed at the Battle of Stamford Bridge weeks before the Norman Conquest

figures.name: Cnut the Great
figures.title: King of England, Denmark, and Norway
figures.description: Danish prince who conquered England and built a vast North Sea Empire, remembered for the legend of commanding the tide to demonstrate the limits of kingly power

figures.name: Ivar the Boneless
figures.title: Viking leader
figures.description: Son of Ragnar Lothbrok who led the Great Heathen Army that invaded England in 865, a brilliant strategist whose epithet 'Boneless' remains debated by historians

figures.name: Lagertha
figures.title: Viking shieldmaiden and ruler
figures.description: Legendary Viking shieldmaiden described in the Gesta Danorum as a fierce warrior who fought alongside Ragnar Lothbrok and later became a ruler in her own right

figures.name: Bjorn Ironside
figures.title: Legendary King of Sweden
figures.description: Son of Ragnar Lothbrok who according to legend raided the Mediterranean, sacking towns in France, Spain, and Italy, eventually becoming the first king of the Munsö dynasty

figures.name: Erik the Red
figures.title: Norse explorer and colonizer
figures.description: Exiled from Iceland for manslaughter, he explored and colonized Greenland, naming it to attract settlers — father of Leif Erikson

works.title: Vikings
works.creator: Michael Hirst
works.description: Historical drama following the legendary Norse hero Ragnar Lothbrok and his descendants as they raid, trade, and explore from Scandinavia to England, Francia, and beyond

works.title: The Northman
works.creator: Robert Eggers
works.description: Visceral Viking revenge epic loosely based on the legend of Amleth (the source of Shakespeare's Hamlet), following a Norse prince's quest to avenge his father's murder

works.title: Vinland Saga
works.creator: Makoto Yukimura
works.description: Historical manga following young Thorfinn on a journey of revenge and redemption during the Viking invasion of England under Canute the Great

works.title: Norsemen
works.creator: Jon Iver Helgaker
works.description: Norwegian comedy series depicting the everyday struggles of a Viking village, blending modern sensibilities with historical Viking life for satirical effect

works.title: The 13th Warrior
works.creator: John McTiernan
works.description: An Arab ambassador is drawn into a quest with twelve Viking warriors to combat an ancient terror, based on Michael Crichton's Eaters of the Dead

properties.notes: Canute the Great appears as a major character in Vinland Saga
Leif Erikson referenced in the Vinland exploration arc
Harald Hardrada appears in Vikings Valhalla sequel series
